partnershipPlan: Two young people and two family members from the service's advisory group review the offer letter, the confidentiality rules and the interview guide; the peer support workers help design their own supervision.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: When you are told you have psychosis at nineteen, meeting someone who got through it is worth more than any leaflet.
items.implication: Measure uptake as the first sign that the offer is wanted.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I would only talk to them if I knew it was not going straight back to my psychiatrist.
items.implication: Agree and explain confidentiality rules before the first contact.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We are the ones at home at three in the morning; do not leave us out of it.
items.implication: Include families in the interviews and consider family contact with peer workers.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Some days a young person's story is my story; I need someone to talk to who understands that.
items.implication: Provide lived-experience supervision and track peer worker wellbeing.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If the peer worker ends up booking appointments, we have wasted the post.
items.implication: Protect the role with a written description.

summary: Five composite voices on shared experience, confidentiality, families, peer worker support and role clarity.
